data.title: 五更琉璃 · 散落床单的命定仪式情缠
data.description: 凌乱的床铺间，黑色蕾丝睡衣早已半褪。黑猫双手死死抓着你的肩膀，修长双腿紧紧环绕，在极致的欢愉与契合中流下喜悦的泪水，将全部命运与身心彻底烙印在你的怀中。

data.action: pinned on messy bed with black lace negligee slipping off pale chest, grasping partner shoulders passionately, crying tears of ecstasy during lovers union
data.lighting: dim moonlight mingling with warm bedside lamp
data.mood: intense romantic consummation, written-in-the-stars destiny, unreserved lovers bliss
